defects: Plan retries every upstream request but does not preserve POST body for second attempt. Current proxy passes one-shot `request.body` directly to upstream; after first 502/503 response consumes it, retry cannot resend same bytes. Common model POST then returns retry failure instead of succeeding on second response.

Liveness table claims exhausted 5xx is model outcome while proxy remains live, but plan neither defines outcome predicate nor covers missing/partial evidence. Proxy liveness alone does not decide phase; a 503 that prevents transcript start or verifier reward is not `model_outcome`.
